name: What factors should I consider when choosing a drone photographer for my luxury property?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a drone photographer for my luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a drone photographer, consider their experience with luxury real estate, portfolio quality, and understanding of aerial composition. Ensure they are FAA Part 107 certified for legal and safe operation. Evaluate their equipment and post-production capabilities, as high-end drones and skilled editing are crucial for showcasing a luxury property effectively. A key decision factor is whether their style aligns with your property's aesthetic and target audience, ensuring the final images resonate with potential buyers in markets like Aventura or Coral Gables.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a photographer based on their luxury real estate experience, FAA certification, portfolio quality, equipment, and post-production skills.
